items.title: What is happening in Oleshky, the occupied Ukrainian town at the center of a Melania Trump ceasefire?
items.brief: Hundreds of people from an occupied town in southern Ukraine who survived months without basic supplies are being evacuated on Friday under a ceasefire agreement negotiated by first lady Melania Trump .

items.title: Egyptian highway billboard hacked to show porn
items.brief: A billboard stretching across one of Egypt’s biggest highways was hacked on Thursday to broadcast pornographic footage, according to the government and local media.

items.title: World’s largest crypto exchange hit by suspected North Korean hack in world’s largest heist
items.brief: Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, has suspended withdrawals after hackers broke into its digital wallets and stole $6 billion in what appears to be the biggest crypto heist ever.

items.title: An ICE officer has been charged after striking a man with a car in Houston
items.brief: A U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer accused of intentionally ramming his car into a Mexican construction worker in Houston was charged Friday with aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, prosecutors said.

items.title: Canada’s economic break with the US in 5 charts
items.brief: For decades, the United States and Canada worked to build one of the world’s closest economic partnerships, with supply chains, businesses and trade increasingly intertwined.

items.title: Major anti-government protests sweep across Italy
items.brief: Farmers dumped manure on the streets of Turin on Friday as mass demonstrations unfurled across more than 50 cities in Italy.

items.title: Christa Pike makes first public comments since botched execution: ‘Healing is not the same as being okay’
items.brief: Christa Pike , who survived Tennessee’s attempt to execute her by lethal injection a month ago, is speaking out for the first time, saying she is recovering, “but healing is not the same as being okay.”
